'''Section 1138''' was a section of the [[Galactic Republic Charter]] accurate as of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It dictated that prisoners of war had to be treated fairly by their captors. The captive [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Jurnak]] appealed to Section 1138 and requested to be provided with escort, when captured by [[the Barsen'thor]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].

{{Rep-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Section 1138 is one of many [[1138 (easter egg)|references]] throughout ''Star Wars'' media to [[George Lucas]]' first feature film, [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']].
